audit.whatIsWrong: Not one Zaahen ability is named anywhere in either layer. The full layer literally tracks an ability called 'Ultimate' — focus.text reads 'Zaahen Ultimate' — and the rest is 'his combo', 'his E', 'his big spell', 'his sustain', 'his answer', 'his grind damage'.
audit.why: This is the largest sample in the slice at 1476 games and the page contains no mechanical information at all. His kit is Cultivation of War (P), The Darkin Glaive (Q), Dreaded Return (W), Aureate Rush (E) and Grim Deliverance (R), and every one of them changes how the lane is played: the Q slashes twice on his next attack and HEALS him, then recasts into a knockup; the W is an 850-range stab that PULLS you back to him; the E is his only dash and deals max-health damage; the R heals him for a portion of the damage it deals. A page that says 'dash his combo' against that is not advice.
audit.corrected: Cultivation of War (P), The Darkin Glaive (Q) 10/9/8/7/6, Dreaded Return (W) 14/13.5/13/12.5/12 at 850 range, Aureate Rush (E) 10/9.5/9/8.5/8, Grim Deliverance (R) 110/95/80.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json — all five abilities with cooldowns and descriptions

audit.whatIsWrong: Cultivation of War is never mentioned, so the fact that Zaahen can REVIVE appears nowhere on the page.
audit.why: His attacks and abilities against champions build Determination for bonus Attack Damage, and once the bar is filled he gains increased Attack Damage AND the ability to revive. That is the single most decision-changing fact in the matchup and the entry's whole strategy — 'stay the aggressor', 'out-burst him inside your combo window' — is written as if it did not exist. Poking him with short trades is what fills the bar, so the aggression the page recommends is also the thing that arms him. Kill him before it fills or accept that your burst window has to survive a second health bar.
audit.corrected: Cultivation of War (P): every attack and ability on a champion stacks Determination for bonus AD, and a full bar grants increased AD plus a revive. Short chip trades fill it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json — P Cultivation of War: 'grant him stacks of Determination, gaining bonus Attack Damage per stack. When filled with Determination, Zaahen gains increased Attack Damage and can revive.'

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry's core instruction is 'hit-and-run, never stand still' and 'trade and be gone before his answer arrives', with no mention of Dreaded Return.
audit.why: Dreaded Return is an 850-range stab that damages and then PULLS the target toward him, on 14 seconds at rank 1. It is the direct answer to hit-and-run, and it out-ranges everything Ambessa has except her ultimate, so 'be gone before his answer arrives' is exactly the plan it beats. Sidestepping the stab, rather than trusting dash range, is the actual skill of the matchup, and the fourteen seconds after he misses it are the window the page keeps gesturing at without naming.
audit.corrected: Dreaded Return (W), 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, 850 range: a stab that damages and pulls you back to him. Sidestep it, then trade inside the 14s.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json — W Dreaded Return: 'Zaahen stabs in a direction, damaging enemies hit, then pulls them toward him', cd 14/13.5/13/12.5/12, range 850

audit.whatIsWrong: The itemization line is 'Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Eclipse, then Sterak's Gage; boots Plated Steelcaps' with no anti-heal at all, and no note on resistances.
audit.why: Zaahen heals from two separate sources — The Darkin Glaive heals him on a 10-second cooldown, and Grim Deliverance heals him for a portion of the damage it deals — so Grievous Wounds is not optional in a matchup the page describes as won through extended trades. Aureate Rush also deals max-health damage, which means Sterak's Gage and any health stacking partly feed it. Both were flagged by the missing-interactions pass and neither reaches the page.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds before Eclipse: The Darkin Glaive heals every 10s and Grim Deliverance heals off its own damage. Aureate Rush scales off maximum health, so health stacking feeds it.
sources: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json — Q heal, R heal, E percentHealth

audit.whatIsWrong: All four spikes are written without a single ability name or cooldown: 'Your dashes and Q', 'Both ults even the raw lane', 'the dash-reset bruiser pattern', 'his grind damage'.
audit.why: The spike moments themselves are plausible, but a spike card with no mechanism is unusable — the player is told a window exists without being told what opens or closes it. I kept all four moments and all four labels and replaced the reasoning with the kit facts that actually govern each one: Aureate Rush being his single 10s dash at level 2, Grim Deliverance's 110s self-heal at 6, Grievous Wounds timing at first item, and Cultivation of War's revive late.
audit.corrected: Lvl 2: his only dash is a 10s Aureate Rush. Lvl 6: Grim Deliverance, 110s, heals off its damage. 1st item: Grievous Wounds. Late: kill him before Determination fills.

notes: This was the emptiest entry in my slice by a distance — 1476 games, and the full layer tracked a spell called 'Ultimate' with focus.text reading 'Zaahen Ultimate'. I have named all five abilities and attached real cooldowns, but the content prose fields here are unusually short (early 301, mid 302, late 297 characters against 500-700 elsewhere), so the +-10% band left me roughly thirty characters of headroom per field. Several genuinely useful facts therefore did NOT fit and are worth a follow-up once someone is willing to grow those fields: Aureate Rush's max-health scaling in the late-game text, and the Determination revive in the early-game text. KIT-FILE FLAG MISFIRES: champ-data/_kits/zaahen.json tags Dreaded Return (W) with 'knockup' when Riot's text says it PULLS enemies toward him — a pull, not a displacement upward — so I described it as a pull; and it lists 25000 range on both Q and E, which is a tooltip artifact rather than a real range, so I quoted no range for either. champ-data/_kits/ambessa.json separately tags Public Execution with 'heal' and W and R with 'grounding', none of which Riot's descriptions support. WIN RATE: MC_WR_TABLES.ambessa.zaahen is 46.41, matching the packet exactly over 1476 games — see audit point 2 for the chart conflict I did not resolve.
